description: Meet this clean, well-cared-for 2021 Ford F-150 XLT — a terrific blend of capability, comfort, and classic truck style. Powered by Ford’s stout 5.0L Flex-Fuel V8 putting out 400 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque and mated to the smooth 10-speed automatic, this F-150 delivers strong, confidence-inspiring performance for work, play, and everything in between. It’s in excellent overall condition, comes with a clean CARFAX, and has had just one owner — a smart buy for anyone who wants a dependable, ready-to-go pickup. Overall, the 2022 Ram 1500 Rebel Crew Cab 4WD in Billet Silver Metallic offers a powerful mix of rugged capability, modern style, comfort, and technology. Its a capable and versatile full-size pickup thats ready to handle work, adventure, and everyday life with strength and confidence.

With its powerful **EcoBoost 2.3L I-4 gasoline direct injection** engine, this Mustang produces an impressive 310 horsepower, paired with a smooth 6-speed manual transmission for an exhilarating driving experience. Additionally, the **Brake Assist** system detects emergency braking situations and applies maximum power to ensure a quick stop, potentially preventing accidents. Tech-savvy drivers will appreciate the **Selective Internet Access**, allowing you to customize your digital feed with updates on sports, local news, or weather while on the go. Long drives are made more enjoyable with **Cruise Control with Steering Wheel Mounted Controls**, which maintains your desired speed, reducing fatigue and enhancing fuel efficiency. Under the hood, the Mustang EcoBoost is equipped with innovative technologies such as **Variable Valve Timing** and **Cylinder Deactivation**. Variable valve timing optimizes engine efficiency at various RPMs for maximum power delivery, while cylinder deactivation conserves fuel by shutting down unnecessary cylinders when cruising, ultimately saving you money at the pump. The **DOHC** Dual Overhead Cam design of the engine enhances performance, while **Gasoline Direct Injection** ensures a precise fuel-air mixture for improved power and quieter operation. The **Intercooled Turbo** further amplifies performance by forcing cooler, denser air into the combustion chamber, providing an exhilarating experience behind the wheel. Convenience features like the **Proximity Key with Keyless Entry and Push Button Start** make accessing your Mustang effortless. Plus, the **Keyfob Window Control** allows you to open the windows remotely, ensuring a comfortable entry before you even step inside. In summary, the Certified 2018 Ford Mustang EcoBoost stands as an exceptional choice for those seeking a perfect mix of thrilling performance, innovative technology, and essential safety features. Whether youre a passionate automotive enthusiast or simply in search of a stylish and efficient ride, the Mustang EcoBoost is engineered to exceed expectations. 2023 BMW ALPINA B8

BOWERS & WILKINS DIAMOND AUDIO, DRIVING ASSISTANCE PRO PACKAGE, FROZEN PURE GRAY, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2023 BMW Alpina B8 Gran Coupe represents the ultimate expression of Alpina's philosophy: effortless speed blended with long-distance luxury and handcrafted exclusivity. Based on BMW's flagship 8 Series Gran Coupe, the B8 is a comprehensively re-engineered grand touring sedan that delivers exceptional performance with modern creature comforts. Power comes from Alpina's extensively reworked 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8, producing 621 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission and xDrive all-wheel drive, the B8 launches from 0-60 mph in around 3.3 seconds and continues to a top speed of 201 mph––remarkable figures for a nearly 4,800-lb luxury sedan. Unlike BMW's sharper M8 sibling, the B8's chassis tuning prioritizes high-speed stability and ride quality. Alpina-specific springs, dampers, bushings, and suspension geometry create a uniquely compliant yet controlled character, supported by rear-wheel steering and a recalibrated active differential. The result is a grand tourer that feels planted and serene at high speed while remaining agile and confidence-inspiring on winding roads. Visually, the B8 carries Alpina's signature restrained elegance. Subtle aerodynamic enhancements, a discreet rear spoiler, and classic multi-spoke Alpina wheels distinguish it from standard 8 Series models, while exclusive paint finishes––this example wearing Frozen Pure Gray––reinforce its bespoke identity. Inside, the cabin blends BMW's modern digital architecture with traditional Alpina craftsmanship: plush leather upholstery, illuminated badging, crystal-glass iDrive controls, and bespoke instrument graphics create an atmosphere that is both contemporary and artisanal. With Alpina transitioning fully under BMW ownership and the 8 Series nearing the end of its lifecycle, the B8 Gran Coupe is poised to become one of the last independently developed Alpina flagships––an increasingly rare combination of hand-finished exclusivity, V8 power, and understated prestige.

description: The 2025 BMW i7 eDrive50 Sedan is a stunning example of modern automotive engineering, combining luxury, performance, and cutting-edge technology in an all-electric package. This sophisticated sedan is designed to offer an exceptional driving experience while maintaining the elegance and refinement for which BMW is renowned. Finished in a striking Dravit Grey Metallic, the exterior of the i7 exudes a sleek and contemporary appearance. Its design is further enhanced by the M Sport Package, which includes several dynamic features such as the M aero kit, M door sills, M foot rest, Shadowline Exterior Trim, and Carbon Fiber Trim with silver thread and piano black accents. Adding a touch of flair is the distinctive Illuminated Kidney Grille. The sedan rides on impressive 21-inch M Aerodynamic wheels paired with staggered summer tires, ensuring optimal performance and grip on the road. Inside, the i7 provides a luxurious and comfortable environment with Smoke White Extended Merino Leather Upholstery. The premium feel is accentuated by the Anthracite Alcantara Headliner. The front seats offer massaging functions, enhancing comfort during long journeys. Additional interior features include: - Heated and cooled front seats - Heated rear seats - Heated steering wheel - Power adjustable seats with memory settings - Leather-wrapped steering wheel - Multi-zone climate control Packed with state-of-the-art technology, the i7 enhances both convenience and safety. The Driving Assistance Professional Package offers features such as Highway Assistant, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Active Lane Keeping Assistant with side collision avoidance, and Cross-Traffic Alert Front. The Premium Package adds more functionality with Parking Assistant Professional, drive recorder, and Surround View with 3D View. For entertainment and connectivity, the i7 features a premium sound system, satellite radio, and a navigation system. The vehicle supports smart device integration, Bluetooth connectivity, and includes a WiFi hotspot, ensuring seamless connectivity on the go. Under the hood, the BMW i7 is powered by an electric motor, delivering smooth and efficient performance. The rear-wheel-drive configuration, combined with air suspension and active suspension systems, ensures a dynamic and comfortable ride. Its lithium-ion traction battery offers ample range for everyday driving needs. Safety is a top priority in the i7, equipped with features such as a back-up camera, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, front and rear collision mitigation, and a comprehensive airbag system. The sedan also includes a security system and immobilizer for added peace of mind. Overall, the 2025 BMW i7 eDrive50 Sedan is a remarkable vehicle, offering a perfect blend of luxury, performance, and advanced technology. It is an ideal choice for those seeking an eco-friendly yet sophisticated driving experience.

Convenience
  • Remote parking - Fit in anywhere! Remote parking system allows you to pull into or out of a space without having to be in the vehicle, simply use the remote control! It's perfect when the cars next to you are too close for you to be able open your doors. With remote parking, any spot is an open spot!
  • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility smart device wireless mirroring

Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.

This stunning **2019 Mercedes-AMG E63 S** (VIN: WDDZF8KB4KA505805) is a ferocious blend of ruthless performance and sophisticated luxury, cloaked in timeless **black** exterior paint that exudes stealthy menace. Inside, it wraps you in sumptuous **AMG Black Exclusive Nappa Leather** with striking diamond stitching, creating an cockpit of pure opulence and aggression.
Slide into the aggressively bolstered **AMG Performance Seats**, engineered for high-speed cornering yet offering supreme comfort on any drive, while the **AMG Nappa Leather Performance Steering Wheel** delivers perfect grip and tactile feedback. The **black piano lacquer center console** and elegant **Metal Weave** accents add a layer of bespoke sophistication, complemented by a dramatic **black headliner** that heightens the sporty ambiance. **Black seat belts** tie the theme together with subtle edge.
Powering this beast is AMG's handcrafted twin-turbo 4.0L V8, unleashing ferocious acceleration through the **AMG Performance Exhaust System** that roars with thunderous, crackling presence—especially intoxicating in Drift mode via the variable **AMG Performance 4MATIC+** all-wheel drive.
Command the road with jaw-dropping style thanks to the **AMG Night Package**, which adds aggressive high-gloss black exterior accents for a darker, more sinister stance, paired with stunning **20" AMG Twin 5-Spoke Wheels** finished in black accents that demand attention. The **Exterior Lighting Package** illuminates your path with advanced **full LED Intelligent Light System**, **active curve illumination** that bends light into corners, and **intelligent highbeam control** for effortless night driving.
A massive **panorama sunroof** floods the cabin with natural light, while **heated rear seats** ensure passengers enjoy every journey in comfort. The legendary **Burmester Surround Sound System** envelops you in concert-hall audio precision, turning every drive into an immersive sonic experience.
Top it off with the iconic **illuminated Mercedes star** that glows proudly in the grille, announcing your arrival with unmistakable presence, and practical touches like **wheel locking bolts** and **mud flaps** for added protection.
This E63 S Wagon isn't just transportation—it's an adrenaline-fueled masterpiece that combines supercar thrills, family-friendly versatility, and AMG's signature brutality in one irresistible package.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
Technology and Telematics
  • Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Welcome to Greenwood Automotive! A family owned and operated dealership like none other, we've been changing the way customers feel about the car buying experience since 2007. We're proud to offer the very best in quality, selection, and service. Our friendly staff will always go the extra mile to ensure that you get exactly what you need. Take this 2025 Mercedes-Benz CLA AMG CLA 35 for example.... Offered in Cosmos Black Metallic exterior with Black interior, it's certain to make a great addition to your family or business! Take note of all this vehicle has to offer: No Accidents! One Owner! Important/Valuable Packages & Equipment AMG Aerodynamics Package ($1,550 value)
    Safety and Security
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
    • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.
    Technology and Telematics
    • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

To verify availability on this or any vehicle, please contact our client care team at (303) 771-1007 or stop by see us at 18945 Twenty Mile Lane Parker CO 80134. Whether you are looking for German luxury, classic American muscle, a tough truck, or a Jeep, our friendly staff will always go the extra mile to ensure that you get exactly what you need.
